messages:
deploy-bot: launching config-only deploy: routing-default=v2.1, request_timeout=2s->1.6s, tiny_batch.window=20ms->10ms. Canary: 2 hosts in ap-south. /deploy config-only --canary --note="earlyshift-tighten"

mike_backend: change window 06:00-07:00 UTC. Any tenant pins?

olivia_pm: payments-tenant must remain on routing:v2.0. Also add note for release: reduce tail latency for micro-interactions.

mike_backend: adding tenant-exclude now. /rules add --tenant=payments-tenant --policy=routing:v2.0 --note="regulatory pin"

deploy-bot: Rule added id=rule_10021

anya_oncall: canary up. Watching p99, request_5xx_rate, and kvcache_queue_length. I'll post if I see spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary status: hosts=2/2, health=passing, metrics hooked.

mike_backend: will run canary 8m then ramp to 12% over 4m. Rollback if p99 > +15% or 5xx > +0.3%.

anya_oncall: 9m in: p50/p95 stable, p99 down 2%. No 5xx. Proceeding to 12% ramp.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramping to 12%.

sam_sre: heads up: making autoscale aggressive for 30m. Also adding temporary alert: page if cluster 5xx > 0.5% for 10m.

anya_oncall: 10m into ramp: small p99 blip on chat microflows, trace ids: c9e2. Router 5xx at 0.18% (baseline 0.05%). Not yet breach.

mike_backend: logs show tiny-batch window applied but some hosts in model_pool_c showing higher GC. I'll cap ramp to 8% and enable host fallback for any host with 5xx > 0.2%.

deploy-bot: adjusting weight 0.12->0.08. Applying host overrides for host-77.

anya_oncall: after adjustment: 5xx dropped to 0.06%, p99 back to baseline. Good.

olivia_pm: record action items: investigate GC pattern on model_pool_c and add auto-guard to rollout. Filing ticket INC-1155.

mike_backend: will add guard to rollout config: if host errors >0.2% reduce weight by half and pin host to previous routing.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 8% traffic. payments-tenant remains pinned to routing:v2.0. Actions logged: PR-5010 (guard change), INC-1155 (pool_c GC).

anya_oncall: I'll monitor for another 20m and then we can decide to resume or rollback. :thumbsup:
